name: Kingy AI Price Index
citation: Kingy AI Price Index, May 2026 edition. Kingy AI. https://kingy.ai/ai-price-index/2026-05/

edition.label: May 2026
edition.headline: In May 2026, a million AI tokens cost a median $3.75 from frontier models (no change), $1.41 from mid-range models (no change) and $0.37 from small models (down 20.3%). A typical AI subscription cost $20.00 a month (no change), and top plans cost $200.00 (no change). Changes compare with April.

story.title: Small-model prices fell 20.3% in May
story.text: The median small model cost $0.37 per million tokens, down from $0.46 in April. DeepSeek is now counted.
